rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server integrates with Google Drive and Google Sheets, enabling AI assistants to create, read, update, and manage spreadsheets. Built by Xing Wu, it provides tools for retrieving sheet data, updating cells, adding rows and columns, creating new spreadsheets, and listing available documents. The implementation supports both OAuth and service account authentication methods, making it suitable for personal assistants that need to interact with spreadsheet data or automate document workflows without requiring users to switch contexts.
